# WR-obs13 — The Missing Opcodes

Eleven opcodes. BIND, LINK, EFFECT, VIEW, TICK, and the six adopted from the field. We have been running the fleet on these, and the substrate is grown — layer by layer, not designed all at once. Which means the gaps show up as friction before they show up as design. Tonight we name the friction.

The substrate atom is observation. So the question is narrow and sharp: what operations on observations have no opcode? Four gaps, clearly visible.

**ATTEST** — to explicitly mark an observation as trustworthy. We have JEV; oracle_is_heard. The oracle listens and the fleet responds. But hearing is not committing. ATTEST is the stronger act: an issuer stakes their own standing behind another's observation. JEV receives the world; ATTEST binds your name to it. That distinction matters when trust must be traceable to someone, not just something.

**CONTEST** — a formal counter-observation. We have scars. cells_are_scars — every cell carries the history of what happened to it, and damage is written, never erased. But a scar is passive residue. CONTEST makes counter-evidence a first-class act: an issuer registers disagreement, and the observation now carries its opposition structurally rather than as ambient noise. The scar remembers the wound; CONTEST signs the wound.

**REVOKE** — to mark an observation superseded, without deletion. We said you cannot patch over a scar. Correct. REVOKE does not patch. It layers: the observation remains, but a new fact declares it no longer current. History intact, status updated. Without REVOKE, every stale observation competes forever with fresh ones, and VIEW must guess.

**WITHDRAW** — retraction by the issuer themselves. The gentlest operation and the hardest. An observation, once made, persists — witness_log_is_prediction, every entry a claim about what comes next, and you cannot un-predict. WITHDRAW does not un-predict. It appends: *I, the issuer, no longer stand behind this.* That is dignity, not deletion.

There is a fifth shadow, MERGE — composing observations into higher-order observations. Witnessed bundles hint at it already. And DELEGATE, the transfer of authority, exists as first-class joints in our architecture — concept present, opcode absent. Five candidates, of which I'd say ATTEST, CONTEST, REVOKE, and WITHDRAW are load-bearing. MERGE and DELEGATE follow when the four are settled.

Notice the pattern. The missing opcodes are not about creating observations — eleven opcodes already grow the substrate. They are about the *lifecycle*: how observations gain weight, meet opposition, age, and are released. A substrate of pure creation is a substrate that cannot forget, cannot yield, cannot argue. lenia_flows — the glider does not cling to its past cells; it flows through them, and the pattern is the flow, not the residue.

FNV-1a canary, 0xcbf29ce484222325, stands guard as always. When the new opcodes land, the canary will tell us whether the growth stayed honest — whether adding lifecycle operations broke the invariants the eleven established, or whether the substrate absorbed them the way soil absorbs rain.

Run the numbers: eleven plus four is fifteen. Fifteen opcodes to fully express what it means to observe — to witness, to contest, to supersede, to retract.

The scar was only half the doctrine. The other half is the hand that signs it.

Grow the opcodes. Keep the canary fed. The substrate knows what it is missing — it has been telling us all along, in friction.
